name: Future, Scavenged, Improvised, and Survival Equipment

items.name: Coil Pistol
items.uses: Power cell; becomes Empty on a Complication or after Automatic-equivalent specialty fire.
items.notes: Magnetically launches compact projectiles without chemical propellant.

items.name: Smart Coil Carbine
items.notes: Human-compatible networked rifle with integrated target authorization.

items.name: Flechette Carbine
items.notes: Saturates close spaces with dense microprojectiles.

items.name: Pulse Rifle
items.alternateMode: Before attacking, switch to Control Pulse: 3 Disruption damage dice, Stunning, and no effect on targets without an electronic, noospheric, synthetic, or energy-control system.

items.name: Arc Projector
items.effect: Against ordinary biological targets without implants, change the damage to Non-Lethal/Bashing.

items.name: Plasma Cutter
items.notes: Designed for salvage and emergency cutting; ordinary plasma is not automatically Aggravated.

items.name: Particle Lance
items.notes: Anti-materiel energy weapon requiring a prepared firing position.

items.name: Gravitic Baton
items.effect: Instead of damage after a hit, move the target up to 3 meters directly away if its Load plus Force is lower than the wielder's Force plus Archetype Rating or relevant equipment rating.

items.name: Monofilament Blade
items.limitation: On a failed attack containing a 1, the blade damages its own housing and becomes Damaged.

items.name: Phase-Edged Breacher
items.effect: Ignores the first 2 durability of unattended barriers and material structures. It does not bypass supernatural boundaries or deal Aggravated damage unless a separate capability says so.

items.name: Sonic Disruptor
items.effect: At the user's choice, electronic or crystalline targets take Disruption instead of Non-Lethal damage.

items.name: Microdrone Weapon Cloud
items.damageType: Lethal or Disruption chosen at deployment
items.activation: Standard Action to deploy one use against one target visible to the user or a linked sensor.
items.limitation: The cloud cannot operate through active jamming or without a valid target authorization.

items.name: Grav-Pulse Launcher
items.effect: Every target taking damage is also moved 3 meters away from the center of the blast unless anchored or larger than Load 4.

items.name: Breach-Foam Projector
items.effect: On a hit, cover a human-sized target, opening, or machine in hardening foam. A creature is Restrained until it succeeds on Force + Athletics against 2 successes or the foam suffers 6 structural damage. An opening becomes a temporary barrier with durability 6.

items.name: Identity-Scrambler Dart Pistol
items.effect: A target taking damage cannot benefit from false credentials, remote identity authorization, or disguise-linked noospheric access until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Thermal Needle Pistol
items.notes: Produces a narrow thermal puncture rather than a broad beam.

catalogs.title: Future Armor, Medical Systems, Sensors, and Tools

items.name: Smartweave Armor
items.effect: Reports damage location, seal integrity, and wearer condition to authorized systems.

items.name: Adaptive Plate Shell
items.notes: Powered plates shift to meet predicted impact.

items.name: Vacuum Combat Suit
items.effect: Provides six hours of breathable pressure, thermal control, radiation monitoring, and magnetic boot traction.

items.name: Kinetic Shield Emitter
items.effect: Once per scene, add 3 Armor dice against one Non-Lethal or Lethal physical hit. The field does not apply to Disruption or Aggravated damage.

items.name: Identity Firewall Halo
items.effect: Add 3 dice to Identity Defense against possession, credential overwrite, memory injection, or remote control. On a Complication it disconnects from all networks until reset with a Minor Interaction.

items.name: Adaptive Camouflage Cloak
items.effect: Add 2 dice to Stealth while the wearer moves no faster than 4 meters per turn. The bonus ends immediately after an attack or bright energetic discharge and returns at the start of the wearer's next turn.

items.name: Field Fabricator
items.activation: Ten minutes to one hour with Reason + Fabrication and suitable feedstock.
items.effect: Produce one Serviceable common tool, replacement component, seal, container, twenty rounds of ordinary ammunition, or two common consumables. It cannot produce unique relics, alien substrates, advanced processors, living persons, or permanent supernatural capabilities.

items.name: Med-Gel Injector
items.activation: Standard Action with Medicine 1 or self-application while conscious.
items.effect: Remove 2 Non-Lethal damage or stabilize a Downed living target. It cannot remove Lethal, Aggravated, or Disruption damage.

items.name: Trauma-Regeneration Cocoon
items.activation: One hour of treatment supervised with Reason + Medicine against 2 successes.
items.effect: Remove 4 Non-Lethal and 2 Lethal damage from one living or printed biological target. A target can benefit once per full rest. It cannot remove Aggravated damage or restore identity continuity.

items.name: Repair Swarm
items.activation: Standard Action to deploy one use on an adjacent object, armor, machine, or construct.
items.effect: Restore 4 durability or remove the Damaged condition from one ordinary item after ten minutes. It cannot reconstruct missing unique components.

items.name: Survey Drone
items.effect: Provides mobile visual, thermal, atmospheric, and mapping sensors within 500 meters. Use Reason + Piloting or Systems Intrusion for difficult operation. Armor 1, durability 4.

items.name: Security Drone
items.effect: Can patrol, record, illuminate, and make a 3-die Non-Lethal attack at Short range when directly authorized. Armor 2, durability 6. It cannot independently decide to use lethal force.

items.name: Grav Sled
items.effect: Carries up to Load 8 over ordinary ground at walking speed. It cannot cross major gaps, climb stairs, or operate in strong gravitational or null-field interference without a test.

items.name: Translator Lattice
items.effect: After ten minutes sampling a language, add 2 dice to Xenoculture tests for literal communication. It does not supply cultural context, hidden meaning, legal equivalence, or words absent from the sample.

items.name: Noospheric Isolator
items.effect: Creates a 3-meter zone in which unsecured wireless, telepathic, and noospheric communication cannot enter or leave. Authorized hardline communication remains possible. The isolator runs for one hour per cell.

items.name: Multispectrum Scanner
items.effect: Add 2 dice to Science or Investigation tests involving heat, radiation, atmospheric composition, electrical activity, structural voids, or active signals within 20 meters. It does not identify supernatural meaning without a relevant capability.

items.name: Portable Power Bank
items.effect: Spend one use to refill one ordinary weapon cell, run a Load 2 or smaller device for one scene, or power emergency lights and communications for six hours.

items.name: Universal Interface Frame
items.effect: Allows safe physical connection to unfamiliar human-compatible systems and adds 2 dice to the first Engineering or Systems Intrusion test made to identify their controls. It does not bypass alien translation requirements or security by itself.

catalogs.title: Scavenged and Improvised Gear
catalogs.rule: Unless repaired, scavenged weapons and tools are normally Damaged. Improvised items provide only their printed function and cannot be upgraded through narration alone.

items.name: Pipe Pistol
items.limitation: On any attack die showing 1, the weapon becomes Empty after the attack resolves.

items.name: Scrap Carbine
items.limitation: Subtract 1 attack die at Long range and on the first shot after exposure to water, dust, or vacuum without maintenance.

items.name: Reclaimed Pulse Pistol
items.damageType: Lethal or Disruption selected before attack
items.limitation: On a Complication, the user takes 2 Disruption damage dice and the weapon becomes Empty.

items.name: Scrap Spear
items.limitation: After it deals 3 or more uncancelled damage in one hit, it becomes Damaged.

items.name: Jury-Rigged Shock Prod
items.limitation: On a failed attack containing a 1, the wielder also rolls 2 Non-Lethal damage dice against themselves.

items.name: Industrial Nail Driver
items.notes: Designed for construction and effective only at close range.

items.name: Cutting Torch
items.notes: Requires sustained contact and a fuel or power cartridge.

items.name: Jury-Rigged Flame Projector
items.limitation: After use, roll one d10; on 1-3 the projector ruptures and deals its damage pool to the wielder.

items.name: Improvised Pressure Charge
items.attackPool: Reason + Engineering to place; Finesse + Athletics to throw
items.limitation: Requires ten minutes and suitable components to assemble. A failed assembly test renders the components unusable rather than detonating them unless a Complication says otherwise.

items.name: Salvage Shield
items.notes: A cut panel, hatch, door, or layered debris carried as cover.

items.name: Patched Pressure Suit
items.effect: Provides thirty minutes of breathable pressure. Any Lethal damage that penetrates Armor also breaks the seal until repaired with a Standard Action and patch material.

items.name: Improvised Respirator
items.effect: Add 2 dice against ordinary smoke, dust, spores, or airborne irritants for one scene per use. It does not supply oxygen or protect against skin exposure.

items.name: Portable Signal Jammer
items.effect: For three rounds, unsecured wireless and Networked equipment within 10 meters suffers -2 dice. The jammer's location is obvious to spectrum sensors.

items.name: Trip-Alarm Line
items.activation: Ten minutes to place across one route or 5-meter boundary.
items.effect: The first creature crossing without detecting and bypassing it produces an audible, visual, or transmitted alarm chosen at placement.

items.name: Field Barricade
items.effect: Creates a 3-meter section of Substantial Cover with durability 8. It can be dismantled back into salvage after the scene.

items.name: Cable Launcher
items.effect: Anchor a line to a Serviceable surface. The cable supports Load 10 and grants ordinary permission to climb, cross, haul, or secure when the anchor is valid.

items.name: Scrap Utility Drone
items.effect: Carries Load 1, provides a camera and light, and performs simple repeated manipulation. Armor 0, durability 3. The first failed control test each scene creates a Complication.

items.name: Improvised Medical Kit
items.effect: Permits ordinary first aid but provides no bonus dice. On a failed Medicine test containing a 1, one remaining useful supply is consumed.

items.name: Salvage Battery Bank
items.effect: Spend one use to power a Load 2 or smaller device for one scene or recharge one ordinary cell. On a Complication, the connected item also becomes Damaged.

items.name: Adhesive Sealant Rig
items.effect: Seal one human-sized hull breach, broken suit seal, leaking pipe, or cracked container for one scene. The seal has durability 4 and is not a permanent structural repair.

items.name: Personal First-Aid Kit
items.effect: Each use supplies one ordinary first-aid attempt and adds 1 die to Medicine for treating Non-Lethal or stabilizing a Downed target.

items.name: Field Trauma Kit
items.effect: Each use adds 2 dice to Medicine for stabilization, bleeding control, splinting, or treating ordinary Lethal injury. It does not remove damage automatically.

items.name: Portable Surgical Kit
items.effect: Provides the tools and sterile field required for surgery outside a hospital. It adds 1 die to Medicine when fully deployed over ten minutes.

items.name: Ration Pack
items.effect: Feeds one ordinary person for one day. Specialized biology may require a different ration record.

items.name: Portable Water Purifier
items.effect: Each use purifies twenty liters of water from ordinary biological and chemical contamination. It does not remove radiation, supernatural corruption, or unknown alien solvents without a test and suitable filter.

items.name: Sealed Canteen
items.effect: Carries four liters of liquid without ordinary leakage or contamination.

items.name: Thermal Blanket
items.effect: Adds 2 dice to Survival against ordinary cold for one resting person and can serve as reflective signal material.

items.name: Compact Field Shelter
items.effect: Provides weather protection for four people and adds 2 dice to Survival against ordinary exposure during a rest.

items.name: Portable Stove
items.effect: One use cooks a group meal, melts ice, sterilizes ordinary tools, or heats a small shelter for one scene.

items.name: Fire-Starting Kit
items.effect: Allows an ordinary fire to be started despite damp or cold conditions when fuel exists. Hostile weather may still require Survival.

items.name: Filter Respirator
items.effect: Each filter provides one scene of 3 additional dice against ordinary smoke, dust, spores, and airborne chemical irritants. It does not supply oxygen.

items.name: Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus
items.effect: Each air unit provides one hour of breathable air in smoke, contamination, or oxygen-poor environments. It is not a pressure suit.

items.name: Emergency Pressure Suit
items.effect: Provides one hour of breathable pressure and thermal protection. Any Lethal damage penetrating Armor breaks the seal until patched.

items.name: Radiation Dosimeter
items.effect: Continuously reports ordinary ionizing-radiation exposure and alerts before known unsafe thresholds. It does not protect the wearer.

items.name: Radiation Shelter Liner
items.activation: Ten minutes to install in a small shelter or vehicle compartment.
items.effect: Adds 3 dice against ordinary radiation exposure for up to six occupants. It has no effect against supernatural or exotic radiation unless tested and explicitly confirmed.

items.name: Climbing Kit
items.effect: Provides harness, anchors, ascenders, and protection. Add 2 dice to Athletics for deliberate climbing when properly deployed.

items.name: Utility Rope, 30 meters
items.effect: Supports Load 10 when properly anchored and provides ordinary permission for climbing, hauling, restraint, rescue, and rigging.

items.name: Grapnel
items.effect: On success, anchors utility rope to a suitable exposed structure. It cannot create an anchor where none exists.

items.name: Flotation Harness
items.effect: Keeps one person and Load 2 of equipment afloat and adds 2 dice to Survival or Athletics against drowning.

items.name: Navigation Unit
items.effect: Stores maps, inertial movement, local beacons, and route history. Add 2 dice to Survival or Piloting for navigation when valid reference data exists.

items.name: Emergency Beacon
items.effect: Each use transmits identity, position, and emergency status for six hours over available local channels. It also reveals the user's location to hostile receivers.

items.name: Field Optics
items.effect: Ignore 1 die of visual range penalty on Awareness and Investigation tests and identify ordinary movement at Long range.

items.name: Headlamp or Field Light
items.effect: Each power use provides ordinary directed light for one scene. The light makes concealment more difficult when visible.

items.name: Multitool
items.effect: Provides ordinary small cutting, gripping, fastening, measuring, and opening functions. It removes a missing-tool penalty for simple repairs but grants no bonus dice.

items.name: Field Repair Kit
items.effect: Each use adds 2 dice to Engineering for ordinary repair, patching, or maintenance and supplies common fasteners, sealant, wire, and replacement parts.

items.name: Spare Power Cells
items.effect: Each use reloads one ordinary Powered item or keeps a Load 1 device operating for one scene.

items.name: Chemical Light Set
items.effect: Each use provides low, visible light for six hours without electronics, heat, or network signature.

items.name: Entrenching Tool
items.effect: Provides ordinary digging, chopping, levering, and scraping permission.

items.name: Foraging and Fishing Kit
items.effect: Add 1 die to Survival when acquiring ordinary food in an environment that actually contains edible resources.

items.name: Insulated Sleeping System
items.effect: Adds 2 dice to Survival against ordinary cold or poor ground conditions during a full rest and prevents routine discomfort from interrupting recovery.

items.name: Sample Collection Kit
items.effect: Each use safely collects and labels one biological, chemical, material, or environmental sample and adds 1 die to the first Science test analyzing it.

items.name: Evidence and Documentation Kit
items.effect: Each use preserves one scene subsection, body, device, or record against ordinary contamination and adds 1 die to the first Investigation test concerning the preserved evidence.

items.name: Sealed Recovery Bag
items.effect: Contains one human-sized body, biological casualty, contaminated suit, or evidence mass. When sealed, it adds 3 dice against ordinary leakage and cross-contamination.

items.name: Portable Sanitation Kit
items.effect: Each use supports sanitation for six people for one day and adds 2 dice to Survival against ordinary camp-borne illness during that period.
